scripts.generate:
node .. --idl2peer --feature=arkui --language arkts --arkts-extension .ets --base-dir idl/sdk,idl/predef --input-dir $(find idl/sdk -type d | tr '
' ','),idl/predef --options-file ../../external/arkoala-arkts/arkui/config/arkgen-config.json
scripts.gen:m3:
node ../../arkgen --idl2peer --reference-names ets --input-files $(find idl -name *.idl | tr '
' ',') --generator-target arkoala --options-file ../../external/arkoala-arkts/arkui/config/arkgen-config.json --language arkts --use-memo-m3 --interop-types ../../external/interop/src/cpp/interop-types.h --output-dir out.m3 --arkts-extension .ets
scripts.gen:subset:m3:
node ../../arkgen --idl2peer --reference-names ets --input-files $(find subset/idl/sdk -name *.idl | tr '
' ','),subset/idl/predef/AttributeUpdater.idl,subset/idl/predef/ModifierState.idl --generator-target arkoala --options-file ../../external/arkoala-arkts/arkui/config/arkgen-config.json --language arkts --use-memo-m3 --interop-types ../../external/interop/src/cpp/interop-types.h --output-dir subset/out.m3 --arkts-extension .ets
